I have grown beans on this plot for many years using seed I save from the previous harvest. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or pesticides, and there is no water for irrigation here, so I depend on the rains. I will put manure from my cattle on the plot before planting because it makes the soil good. My family will do all the work since the plot is not big, and we have no money to pay workers.
